title: [Decision] The published skills: who reviews a change, how they are verified, one catalog or two for code-first and MCP, and the E2 premise reading
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ② a decision card for questions the maintainer put to this seat by name, in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「并且你要完整地重新评估一下所有元数据相关技能，包括技能是否需要经过我审核 用什么样的方式来定期验证和迭代技能？ 纯代码开发的技能和MCP开发的技能是否需要开分开？问数是否需要开新的技能。」 The fourth question (a new 问数 skill) is already ruled and filed as #34685. The E2 point is here because the ruling on #34659 (comment 6940528935) orders the seat to report the fork when its premise fails.

Ruled: 6943107981 · S1 A; S2 A; S3 A; F1 B · 2026-11-17T08:42:11Z

## 维护者速读

- **一句话**：今天一个通过 MCP 搭建或问数的用户，装不上、也触发不了我们发布的技能；而技能改得对不对，目前没有任何程序去验证。
- **S1 谁审技能改动**：建议维持现状。只改措辞的由席位过契约审核后落地；新增、删除、重命名和涉及安全的才到你手里。
- **S2 怎么验证**：建议让技能目录里已有的 208 个评测用例真的跑起来，每周一轮，并把「失败用例修后通过」作为技能修复的验收。
- **S3 代码与 MCP 是否分开**：建议知识只留一份，流程分两份。
- **F1（E2 的前提）**：只成立一半。建议改裁：指标查不到时，服务器返回相近候选并提示可能有多种口径，只供反问，不自动选中。（本条推荐于 2026-11-17T10:17Z 由 A 改为 B，理由见 F1 一节。）
- **需要你做的**：对 S1、S2、S3、F1 逐条回字母，都同意推荐就回「全部 A」。

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, read 2026-11-17)

- **Catalog.** 11 skills. Six teach metadata authoring (data, ui, automation, formula, i18n, query); four do not (api, platform, upgrade, objectui); `objectstack-ai` teaches building AI features into an app.
- **Triggers.** Every metadata skill's description triggers on TypeScript file globs (`*.object.ts`, `*.flow.ts`, `*.view.ts` …). A client working over MCP has no such file. Only `objectstack-i18n` also names the metadata API.
- **Examples.** Code fences in the six metadata skills: 204 TypeScript, 2 JSON.
- **Hosted coupling.** The cloud reads 24 sections of the data, ui and automation skills by exact heading text and serves them verbatim to MCP clients, TypeScript fences and `import` lines included. A renamed heading throws at cloud module load. No gate in this repository knows those headings.
- **Evals.** `skills/*/evals/*.json` hold 208 cases in 26 files. Nothing runs them against a model. The only mechanical use is `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, which checks that each `must_contain` token occurs in the skill's own Markdown.
- **Behavioural measurement.** Scenario cards run on the eval seat's own schedule, not in CI; that seat is vacant (#34632). No loop re-tests a skill change before or after it lands.
- **Governance.** `skills/**` is Tier H in `GOVERNED_SURFACES` (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:1374`), with a low-risk arm that reads Tier S when every catalog file is modified (not added, deleted or renamed), only `.md` and `evals/*.json` change, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, a patch changeset, nothing security-shaped, and a PASS contract review on the head.
- **Volume.** 73 merged PRs titled `docs(skills…` since 2026-11-10 (search, title proxy).
- **Distribution.** `create-objectstack` installs the catalog into `.claude/skills/`. No `os` command refreshes it. A user who only ran `claude mcp add` has no documented way to install it.
- **F1 reading.** `examples/app-crm`, 12 questions, three arms, five repetitions each, `claude -p --model haiku --effort medium`, subscription login. The skill effect is stable across the repetitions and every checkable number is right in all arms. With the ask-back branch the client asked back on one near-miss word every time and on another in three of five runs; on a bare two-word question it loaded no skill at all. It asked back on none of the 45 runs that had a single right reading. Scores are with the maintainer.

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 (governed surfaces and their tiers); `lowRiskArmVerdict` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:475-520`.
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive #12 (contract-first: reject at authoring or publish, never tolerate in a consumer).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` (the eval seat's rounds and boundaries).
- ADR-0149 D3 (exact matching of dataset terms), for F1.
- No option below changes a spec schema or a metadata contract.

## S1. Who reviews a change to a published skill

| | Does | What a customer sees | Effort |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **A (rec)** | Keep today's tiers | Nothing changes | none |
| B | Every skills PR waits for the maintainer | Fixes to wrong teaching wait behind about 70 PRs a week | skills · rule text only · no precedent |
| C | Every skills PR lands at seat tier, new skills included | A new skill can ship with no human having seen its trigger | skills · rule text only · no precedent |

A in business terms: the editor signs off new sections of the manual; proofreading does not wait for the editor.

## S2. How the skills are verified and iterated

| | Does | What a customer sees | Effort |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **A (rec)** | A runner executes the 208 existing eval cases through Claude Code on the subscription and grades them mechanically; a weekly round, plus the touched skill's cases when a skills PR changes it; a skill fix is accepted when its failing case passes | Wrong teaching is found by a run, not by a customer | devx · 1 runner PR + the eval seat's routine · no precedent for the runner; this seat's 180-run ask pilot took about 35 minutes with no API spend |
| B | Scenario cards only, weekly | Coverage stays at the 9 cards' breadth; the 208 cases stay unread | eval seat · routine only |
| C | Unchanged | As today | none |

A in business terms: the textbook has exercises with answers already printed; today nobody sits the exam.

## S3. One catalog or two, for code-first and for MCP

| | Does | What a customer sees | Effort |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **A (rec)** | One copy of the shape knowledge, two thin procedures. The six metadata skills gain a trigger for authoring over MCP, and the 24 sections the cloud already serves gain a JSON form beside the TypeScript. A thin "build over MCP" procedure skill (inspect, read the contract, save a draft, read the publish verdict, hand over to a person) is written when the draft door exists | An MCP client is taught in the form it writes; code-first is untouched | skills · about 3 PRs over the 24 sections + 1 with the draft door · no precedent |
| B | A second full catalog for MCP | Two manuals that drift; every rule is fixed twice | skills · about 6 new skills · no precedent |
| C | Unchanged | An MCP client keeps reading TypeScript examples, or nothing | none |

A in business terms: one rulebook, with a quick-start card for each of the two ways in.

## F1. The E2 premise held only in part

| | Does | What a customer sees | Effort |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| A | E2 stays B. The skill's ask-back wording is iterated once on #34685, and the formal reading is #34687's five-repetition round | On some near-miss words the client may still pick a reading silently until that round | skills · inside #34685 · none extra |
| **B (rec)** | Re-rule E2 to A now: `list_datasets` returns a `candidates` list on a zero-match, never auto-selected | The ask-back no longer depends on the client's wording | spec + server · 2 PRs · touches ADR-0149 D3 · no precedent |


Read after this card was first filed, and the reason the F1 recommendation moved from A to B:

- Comparable servers answer a zero-match in the tool result. Lightdash `grep_fields` returns "No exact grep matches. Closest catalog matches (fuzzy search…)" and an ambiguity note; Snowflake Cortex Analyst documents a `suggestions` field; Metabase and Cube search by similarity. None of those read leaves it to client wording alone. (Source read 2026-11-17; Cube from its docs only.)
- A tool result is read by any client that made the call. A tool description is read only after the client chose the tool, and a skill only when it is installed and triggered.
- On the live hosted CRM environment the natural words `revenue`, `deals` and `customers` matched nothing, although several measures contain them.
- The candidates never select: "what counts as a match" in ADR-0149 D3 does not change; the ADR gains a note.

## 四维分析

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：S1-A、S2-A、S3-A 都在缩小特例。S3-A 让「元数据形状」只有一处权威，两年后的样子是一本规则书加两张入门卡，和主流平台「一套 schema 文档、多种接入方式」的建模一致；S3-B 是两套会漂移的手册。S2-A 把已有但没人执行的用例变成真的检查，不新增契约。F1-A 不动 ADR-0149 D3 的精确匹配。
② 实际业务拉动：今天撞上的是每一个只做了 `claude mcp add` 的用户（装不上技能、触发不了技能），以及云端 MCP 搭建的用户（读到的是 TypeScript 示例）。S1 没有人撞上：现行分档下措辞修复不等人。F1 的近似词问题在示例应用上可复现，真实部署的频率未测。
③ 防 AI 犯错：S2-A 是唯一让「技能教错了」响亮暴露的选项，现在是静默的——教错的技能照样发布，错在客户的应用里才出现。S3-A 让 AI 读到的示例就是它要写的形态，少一次从 TypeScript 到 JSON 的自行翻译。F1-B 比 F1-A 更结构化（服务器给候选，而不是靠措辞）。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：S1-A 零新增。S2-A 新增一个评测运行器，属于维护者点名要的验证方式（原话见卡首），不是 CI 门禁，不拦合并。S3-A 只补已被云端读取的 24 个章节，不铺开到全部技能；薄流程技能推迟到草稿入口落地。F1-A 零新增，F1-B 给工具输出加一个永久字段。
Prior rulings read: "skills Tier S low-risk arm" → 1 hit (#33501, ruled 2026-11-14); "list_datasets candidates exact match" → ADR-0149 D3; thread: #34659 comment 6940528935

Recommendation, from ① alone: S1 A, S2 A, S3 A, F1 B.
自检行：只看①选 S1-A、S2-A、S3-A、F1-B；②③④ 是否翻转：否。F1 的推荐在本卡首次落笔时写的是 A，那是把④（不新增字段）当成了翻字母的理由，不合模板；按①重读后改为 B：服务器给候选对所有客户端（产品内 AI、MCP 客户端、装没装技能）是同一个机制，技能措辞是每个客户端各管各的。

Confidence gaps, stated and not acted on: the PR volume is a title-search proxy; how often a real deployment meets a near-miss word is not measured; the eval runner's cost is extrapolated from the ask pilot, not from a run of the 208 cases.

Analysis-tier: seat tier; not written or re-read at the contract-review tier.

## After the ruling

- S1 A: nothing to do.
- S2 A: one devx card for the runner, and a line in the eval lane's charter for the weekly round; both filed by this seat as epic children. Seating the eval seat is #34632 D9.
- S3 A: skills cards for the triggers and the 24 sections, filed in the draft-door milestone; a framework-side pin of the 24 headings goes with them, so a rename fails here and not at cloud load.
- F1 A: no new card; #34685 and #34687 carry it. F1 B: one spec card and one server card, and an amendment note on ADR-0149.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34685, #34687, #34632 (D9), #33501.
- Dedup, open and closed: `skill "query_dataset" in:title` 0; `dataset synonyms skill teach in:title` 1 hit, #31659 (closed, a teaching card, not this decision).
